name: Minimal Dark
description: Minimalist dark UI for JIVE declarative markup: flat graphite surfaces, hairline borders, a single cool-blue accent and generous whitespace. Reference example containing every component type registered in jive::ComponentFactory on pin 89d5787.

typography.fontFamilyHeadings: system default (JIVE inherits host font; override via style 'font-family')

components.spacing: flex justify-content / padding (gap is grid-only in JIVE)

jiveNotes.styles: JSON only, in style='{}' attribute (background, foreground, border, border-radius, font-*, letter-spacing, text-decoration)
jiveNotes.displayRequired: every element with children needs display="flex"|"grid"|"block"
jiveNotes.editor: <Editor> maps to IgnoredComponent upstream (TextEditor missing, issue #59)
jiveNotes.widgetChrome: toggle/knob/combo box chrome follows host LookAndFeel; JIVE styles control placement, size and text colours
